entries.decision: Add repository-scoped guidance that keeps AudaciTops features and behavior tests maintainable across Audacity audacity3 updates.
entries.reason: The user explicitly requested this policy before continuing feature work and plans to accept future upstream updates; unnecessary upstream edits and incidental test assumptions add avoidable upgrade work.
entries.regression: Preserve requested feature behavior and global authorization gates; permit necessary small upstream hooks with their coupling documented.

entries.decision: Require AudaciTops changes to minimize upstream edits and review changed behavior for unnecessary upgrade coupling and brittle tests.
entries.reason: The user plans a maintained Audacity audacity3 fork. Existing extension points and isolated features reduce conflict work without forbidding necessary upstream hooks.
entries.regression: Preserve feature behavior and global authorization gates. Necessary small hooks remain permitted with their coupling documented. Public behavior tests and capability-based failure fixtures remain permitted; source-layout checks and blanket repeated tests are not required.

entries.decision: Rename the fork AuTopsy and supersede the prior decision 'Require AudaciTops changes to minimize upstream edits and review changed behavior for unnecessary upgrade coupling and brittle tests.' with owned grouping/video timing and explicit Audacity adapter contracts.
entries.reason: The user clarified resilience to upstream evolution rather than edit count as the required objective.
entries.regression: Keep native attachment, command, history, mixer and drag integration; feature tests depend on public behavior and required contracts, not unrelated UI layout or source text.
